text:
maria: Hey team — CedarCloud SI hit a blocker during staging deploy to their marketplace image. Installer fails with image signature mismatch. Can we triage?

sam: ugh, seen that before with the marketplace signing job. Is this the govcloud image or regular?

partner-engineer: regular marketplace image. Partner says installer logs show: 
```
ERROR: image verification failed: digest not found for tag redwood/cust-cedar:v1.2.3
```

cheng: pinging infra signing pipeline now. last successful publish was 2026-03-12. looking at logs.

deploy-bot: [deployment] publish-job-6445 failed — checksum mismatch for artifact af9c3b. retry queued. :warning:

olivia: CedarCloud is on a tight go-live window tomorrow morning. need a workaround if publish takes >1h. any chance we can use a deployment bypass token for staging only?

kevin: we can do a staging bypass but must scope it to their VPC and ephemeral creds. i can generate a short-lived image-allow rule. need partner SA to confirm acceptance.

partner-engineer: they can accept staging bypass for 2 hours. please add an allowlist for 10.0.5.0/24 only.

maria: ok action list: (1) cheng to verify signing pipeline and re-publish, (2) kevin to create staging bypass rule scoped to 10.0.5.0/24, (3) sam to coordinate partner install team and confirm manifests. timeline: 1 hour preferred.

cheng: quick update — signing pipeline failed on the cosign key rotation step. error from keyserver: 502. reaching out to security for KMS health check.

sam: partner has installer logs and can re-run after you publish. partner-engineer is standing by.

kevin: I can apply bypass now. applying rule to staging subnet and adding short-lived token. token: redwood-staging-cedar-tn-01 (expires in 2h). sharing in DM.

maria: thanks kevin. partner please re-run installer once kevin confirms. cheng, keep us posted on republish.

partner-engineer: re-run started — getting a different error now: backend cannot reach telemetry collector (connection timeout). looks like egress blocked to telemetry.redwood.ai:443

sam: that's expected if their subnet doesn't allow that egress. do we require telemetry for staging? can it be deferred?

maria: telemetry is optional for the initial smoke, we can flip a flag in the manifest: `telemetry.enabled=false`. partner try that while we fix egress.

partner-engineer: changing manifest and reapplying...

deploy-bot: [deployment] install-run-998 completed: partial success (core services up, telemetry disabled). :white_check_mark:

cheng: security/KMS confirmed intermittent outage — they've restarted keyserver and re-run cosign; new signed artifact uploaded as redwood/cust-cedar:v1.2.3-signed. please pull and validate.

sam: partner, can you pull `v1.2.3-signed` and re-enable telemetry afterwards?

partner-engineer: pulling now. will test with telemetry=false then an in-place toggle to true.

kevin: note for ops: once go-live is green, we should rotate the staging bypass rule out immediately.

maria: agree. I'll own the rollback of the bypass and the postmortem with partner. tagging follow-ups: @cheng - add root cause KMS flakiness to PM; @kevin - remove bypass at EOD; @sam - confirm production publish timeline with partner.

partner-engineer: all good on our side for now. big thanks for the quick turn. we'll do full regression in the morning.

maria: closing this thread for now. please reopen if anything else breaks. :thumbsup:
